readme_excerpt:
# headscale

An open source, self-hosted implementation of the Tailscale control server.

Headscale aims to implement a self-hosted, open source alternative to the Tailscale control server. It works with the official Tailscale clients and lets you manage your own mesh network.

Features:

- Support for Tailscale clients on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS
- ACL support
- Namespaces (users)
- Easy to deploy via Docker or a single binary

title: ollama
raw_description: Get up and running with OpenAI gpt-oss, DeepSeek-R1, Gemma 3 and other models.
readme_excerpt:
# Ollama

Get up and running with large language models locally.

## Quickstart

Install Ollama, then run a model:

    ollama run llama3

Ollama bundles model weights, configuration, and data into a single package, and exposes a simple REST API on localhost:11434 for chatting and generating embeddings.

title: redis
raw_description: Redis is an in-memory database that persists on disk.
readme_excerpt:
# Redis

Redis is an open source, in-memory data store used as a database, cache, streaming engine, and message broker. It supports data structures such as strings, hashes, lists, sets, sorted sets and streams, and provides persistence with RDB snapshots and AOF logs. Redis also offers replication, Lua scripting, transactions, pub/sub, and high availability with Redis Sentinel and Redis Cluster.

title: duckdb
raw_description: DuckDB is an in-process SQL OLAP database management system
readme_excerpt:
# DuckDB

DuckDB is an in-process SQL OLAP database management system. It is designed to be fast, reliable, portable and easy to use, with zero external dependencies. DuckDB can read and write Parquet, CSV and JSON files directly, and integrates with Python, R, Java and Node.js.

title: tauri
raw_description: Build smaller, faster, and more secure desktop applications with a web frontend
readme_excerpt:
# Tauri

Tauri is a framework for building tiny, fast binaries for all major desktop platforms. It uses a Rust core with a web frontend, so developers can use any frontend framework. The resulting apps are small, use the system webview, and support secure IPC and a pluggable permission system.

title: deno
raw_description: A modern runtime for JavaScript and TypeScript
readme_excerpt:
# Deno

Deno is a simple, modern and secure runtime for JavaScript and TypeScript that uses V8 and is built in Rust. It has secure defaults, supports TypeScript out of the box, ships a built-in test runner, and provides a standard library. Deno also includes a formatter, a linter and the deno task runner.

title: uv
raw_description: An extremely fast Python package and project manager, written in Rust.
readme_excerpt:
# uv

uv is an extremely fast Python package and project manager, written in Rust. It can replace pip, pip-tools, pipx, poetry, pyenv and virtualenv. uv installs packages and manages virtual environments, resolves dependencies, and can manage Python versions, all in a single tool.
